title: Nightly live e2e: scheduled GitHub Actions run of e2e:live against staging with the summary posted to the run and an issue on failure
spec:
Why: no recorded green end-to-end run on production (roadmap 3.1, P0-4). The suite e2e/live/* exists (14 steps, summary reporter writes e2e/live/out/summary.md, credentials only via env, see docs/checks/e2e-live.md).
What:
1. `.github/workflows/nightly-live.yml`: `schedule` cron 03:00 UTC daily plus `workflow_dispatch`; ubuntu-latest, npm ci, `npx playwright install chrome` (the live config uses channel chrome), run `npm run e2e:live` with BASE_URL, E2E_EMAIL, E2E_PASSWORD from repository secrets (names only; the workflow fails fast with a clear message when a secret is missing). Upload e2e/live/out/ as an artifact (retention 14 days). Append summary.md to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. On failure, create or update one GitHub issue titled "Nightly live e2e failed" (label `nightly-live`) with the summary table and the run URL, using `actions/github-script` and GITHUB_TOKEN; on success close that issue if open. Concurrency group so two runs never overlap.
2. `e2e/live/summary-reporter.ts`: also write `e2e/live/out/summary.json` {passed, total, status, steps:[{title,status,ms}]} so the workflow can read counts without parsing Markdown; keep the Markdown output unchanged. Keep every scrub() rule (credentials never reach the summary) and the live.guard.test.ts rules.
3. `docs/checks/e2e-live.md`: new section "Nightly run": the secrets to set (names only), where the results appear (run summary, artifact, the issue), and the acceptance rule from the roadmap: 14/14 green on two consecutive nights before Phase 0 closes, recorded by the human in that doc with the two run URLs.
4. A Vitest guard (e2e/live-nightly.guard.test.ts) parses the workflow YAML (use the yaml package if already present, else a minimal check on required strings) and asserts: secrets are read from `secrets.*` only, no `echo` of them, artifact upload present, concurrency set.
No new dependencies except a YAML parser if none exists (state it). Do not touch README.md, docs/DEPLOY.md, .env.example, .github/workflows/ci.yml or db-tests.yml (another task owns them).
acceptance: .github/workflows/nightly-live.yml exists with schedule + workflow_dispatch, secrets only via secrets.*, artifact upload of e2e/live/out, step summary, issue create/update on failure and close on success, concurrency group (guard test asserts these)
summary-reporter writes summary.json next to summary.md with passed/total/status/steps; existing summary.md content unchanged (reporter test)
e2e/live.guard.test.ts still passes: no credential can reach the summary
docs/checks/e2e-live.md has the Nightly run section with the two-consecutive-nights rule
